name: Monstrocracy - Monster Workplace Democracy
source:
The Boss has left on a business trip, and the employees take charge. Your coworkers want to improve the workplace, and all they're missing is your vote. You decide who's right and who's wrong. Let's make monster workplace democracy happen!

In Monstrocracy, you pack Loot, upgrade your workstation, and bond with your coworkers. Your job performance will determine your alliances.

After all these years on the job, will you finally come to understand the monsters you work with?

[From [url=https://aviala.itch.io/monstrocracy]itch.io[/url]]
